title: Models & providers
description: The governed model estate — declared capabilities and pricing, routing policy, and provider key references. Secrets are never shown; only masked references.

catalog.title: Capability matrix
catalog.description: Declared API capabilities per model family.
catalog.pricingDescription: List-price defaults — reference, not immutable truth. Verify against each provider and override per model.
catalog.capsToConfirmHint: This family's capability set is not yet verified against a model card. The model is listed, but its capabilities are flagged unconfirmed rather than invented.

estate.title: Governed models
estate.description: Models in this tenant's estate, enriched from the catalog.
estate.notEnriched: No declared family yet — no pricing
estate.costNote: Per-token µUSD is a coarse convenience figure; the authoritative cost of real usage is the FinOps ledger.
estate.truncatedHint: There are more governed models than shown; this page takes rows by id. Table search and sorting apply only to what is loaded.

routing.title: Routing policies
routing.description: Policies are defined here and executed by the gateway connector — the UI configures and shows them.
routing.emptyHint: A routing policy selects the primary model and fallback chain for a strategy.

decision.title: Resolved decision
decision.unresolved: No governed model satisfies this policy

routing.executeHint: Resolve is free. Execute calls the provider and spends against your budget.
routing.executeWarning: This runs the resolved model chain against the real provider and records a cost sample. It is not a simulation — use Resolve to preview the decision without spending.
routing.noExecutor: No executor is provisioned. This is not an outage: the control plane resolves routing decisions but never spends against a provider until an operator wires an executor.
routing.budgetDenied: A FinOps budget denied the spend BEFORE any provider call. The governance gate worked — raise or review the budget rather than retrying.
routing.outputNotStored: The output is returned to you and stored nowhere: only a redacted cost sample reaches the ledger.
routing.truncatedHint: There are more routing policies than shown; this page takes rows by id. A policy not listed here does not demonstrate that no policy routes a given request.

keys.title: Provider key references
keys.description: Governed references to provider API keys and workspaces. Only a masked hint is stored — never the secret value.
keys.maskedOnly: Reference only — the secret value is never stored or shown.

dialog.title: Add key reference
dialog.name: Name
dialog.extIdHint: The key/workspace id at the provider (e.g. apikey_01). Not the secret.
dialog.noSecretNote: This form never accepts a secret. Olivares stores a reference and a masked hint only.

keys.truncatedHint: There are more provider key references than shown; this page takes rows by id. A key not listed here does not demonstrate that no credential exists for that provider. Table sorting applies only to what is loaded.

gpai.title: GPAI provider posture
gpai.description: Operator-attested supplier posture, recorded once per provider.
gpai.notice: This is supplier GPAI posture attested by the operator and feeds supplier-evidence needs for ISO/IEC 42001 A.10.3 and NIST AI RMF GOVERN-6.1 / MAP-4.1. It is not a compliance determination by Olivares.
gpai.emptyHint: Attest a provider posture when published supplier material has been reviewed or a claim needs to be recorded.
gpai.verifiedMeaning: Reviewed by the operator against published provider material — this is the operator's own attestation, not verification performed by Olivares and not a compliance determination.

detail.title: GPAI posture: {{provider}}
detail.description: The operator-recorded claims and attestation metadata for this provider.

form.description: Record the provider's claims and the operator's own review attestation.
form.providerLocked: The provider reference is locked while editing because changing it would create a second posture.
form.claimsDescription: Turn on a claim only when the operator has recorded it for this provider.
form.systemicRiskHint: Classification: the model is classified as GPAI with systemic risk.
form.safetyReportHint: This report applies to models classified as GPAI with systemic risk.
form.verificationMethodHint: Required when the operator marks this posture as reviewed.
form.verificationMethodRequired: Describe how the published provider material was reviewed.
form.requestRejected: The posture was not saved. Review the server response below.

gpai.truncatedHint: There are more GPAI postures than shown; this page takes rows by id. A provider not listed here does not demonstrate that nothing was declared for it. Table sorting applies only to what is loaded.

keyRefs.title: No provider key references added yet
keyRefs.description: Add an API key or workspace reference by provider identifier; the console never accepts or stores the credential value.

models.title: No governed models observed yet
models.description: Models enter the estate when a connector emits a cost sample naming the provider and model in use.

residency.title: Workspace residency
residency.description: Where each workspace processes inference and where its data rests, as the provider reports it.
residency.truncatedHint: There are more workspace residency records than shown; this page takes rows by id — assigned at creation — so later rows are missing. A workspace not listed here does not demonstrate that its processing is unrestricted: it may simply be beyond this page.

access.title: Model access rules
access.description: Who may use which model, and where.
access.empty: No access rules — every subject is unrestricted
access.groupsDescription: Named sets a rule can target instead of a single model.
access.confinementNotice: ⛔ An allow is not only additive. A subject NAMED by any allow is CONFINED to its allows — everything else becomes denied for them. A subject named by no rule is unrestricted. So creating the FIRST allow for someone TAKES AWAY the rest of the catalogue from them.
access.forbidSubtracts: This forbid SUBTRACTS: it overrides any allow naming the same subject.
access.confinedSubject: {{subject}} is confined to its allows — anything not listed is denied for them.
access.readOnlyNote: Read-only: changing who may use a model requires models:model-access:admin, which is a higher tier than editing a routing policy.
access.truncatedHint: There are more access rules than shown; this page takes rows by id. The marks on these rows reflect ONLY the loaded rules: allows that would introduce confinement or add permitted targets may be missing, and forbids that subtract access may be missing too — so this page can read wider OR narrower than reality, and a subject with no loaded rule does not appear at all. Do not infer effective access from it: the engine drains every page before deciding, and it resolves a principal across user, role and group, which a row cannot show.
access.groupsTruncatedHint: There are more model groups than shown; this page takes rows by id. A group not listed here does not demonstrate that it does not exist — a rule may still target it.
